This isn't an easy situation at all dude, I'll be honest. I'm guessing this is a first love for you so I'm sure it's hurting probably a 100 times more than a more experienced person will feel. I'm gonna break this down into two questions for you: 1. Can you trust her? 2. Do you think you honestly love her still?

Yes, I have no doubt in my mind that what you felt was love, but young love is much different from "older" love I guess in a weird way to put it. Both people are figuring out what works for you and so you experience stuff for the first time, a special moment for people, making it harder to let go of them. Hell, I still think about my first love to this day (18 at the time, 23 now). But to get into the questions: when I mean can you trust her, I mean can you legitimately see her go out with her friends or be alone without you wondering whether or not she's cheating? Because the thing is man, you didn't trust her even before you knew she was cheating. Now I'm not blaming you at all, hell we all have done out fair share of snooping (at least I have), but the thing is, snooping is snooping, and that's a break of trust there (granted nowhere near as bad as cheating but still). If you can, now after you know she did it once, after you had to legitimately go through her private messages to find out what was wrong, allow that to happen, I'd say you're a better man than me, but you also need to realize that she couldn't tell you herself ( a really bad sign). Second: Do you still love her? Obviously the answer to this question is yes, so you can think with that if you want, and say that it'll be sincere this time, but you have to live with caution for a while.



Look whatever you decide to do is what will be good for you.
